title: Work Okay
text: Work Okay. These are much smaller than I anticipated. I can fit one skinny TV remote and one tiny Roku remote in one pocket. It fits one Xfinity remote and one small sound bar remote in one pocket. If you’ve got a clunkier universal remote, it may not fit at all. It adheres to a surface with a sticker. The entire floral bit is adhesive on the back. It didn’t feel particularly strong, but it is staying put without a problem. Also, one of mine came with a tiny crack. I think this is useful, I just think the quality and size are a bit lacking.
